template.name: Landledger: approve an infrastructure change
template.description: A form (or a pull request webhook) asks for an infrastructure change with its monthly cost: this flow's key raises an infra_change request in Landledger naming the person, who confirms it in their own Landledger session (the flow posts the link) before the cost center’s approvers see it. When they decide, the flow checks the request is its own (this key raised it, from a run of this workflow) and approved, then goes on to the step that applies the change (a placeholder to fill) and a Slack post; a rejection is posted with the approver’s comment.

credentials.name: Landledger (requests)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and requests:write. Never decisions:relay or admin.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish and keeps the signing secret Landledger returns (never shown). Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made, in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.description: A bot token (xoxb-…) with chat:write, invited to #infra-changes.

credentials.name: Webhook secret
credentials.description: The header (e.g. X-Webhook-Token) and secret your CI sends with a pull request’s cost.

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (requests)**: the API URL and an `ll_` key with `read` and `requests:write` (never `decisions:relay` or `admin`).

Pick or add **Landledger (webhooks)** for **Landledger events**: a key of its own with only `webhooks:write`. Publishing subscribes it and keeps the signing secret; or put the `whsec_` secret of a webhook an admin made in its Webhook Signing Secret.
Pick the **Slack bot** for the posts and set their channel (#infra-changes).

Ask with the form at `/form/infra-change`, or let CI post the same fields to the **Pull request webhook** with the **Webhook secret** header. The form is a public URL, so the email it names is a claim: Landledger holds the request until that person confirms it in their own session, and **Post the confirm link** tells them where.

**Ours to act on?** trusts a decision only for a request this flow's key raised from a run of this workflow (the **Landledger infra requests** table records each), approved now; anything else ends in **Not this flow's: refused**.
Replace **Apply the change** with what applies it (merge, deploy, comment on the PR), then add Landledger **Request → Mark Applied** so the request reads applied.
Publish: the form and webhook go live and Landledger starts sending request.needs_confirmation and request.decided to this flow (it must reach `LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL`).

workflow.name: Landledger: approve an infrastructure change
workflow.description: A form or pull request webhook raises an infra_change request in Landledger for the named person to confirm; the approved decision of a request this flow raised is applied (placeholder), a rejection posted, anything else refused.

nodes.name: Infra change form

parameters.formDescription: Landledger asks the person named to confirm the request in their own session, then the cost center’s approvers; you hear back in #infra-changes.

values.fieldLabel: Who asks (their Landbright email; they confirm it in Landledger)

options.formSubmittedText: Sent to Landledger. The person named confirms it there (Requests → To confirm; the link is posted in #infra-changes), then the approvers have it.

nodes.notes: The form is a public URL: Landflow does not know who submitted it, so the email is a claim. Landledger holds the request in awaiting_confirmation until that person confirms it in their own session.

nodes.name: Pull request webhook
nodes.notes: A CI job posts { title, costCenter, monthlyAmount, requester, pullRequestUrl, note, basis } when a pull request adds infrastructure cost.

nodes.name: Ask Landledger
nodes.notes: Raised by this flow's key naming the person: Landledger keeps it awaiting_confirmation until they confirm it, then asks the approvers. The answer comes back through Landledger events below.

nodes.name: Remember the request
nodes.notes: Which run of this workflow raised which request: a decision is trusted only for a request recorded here by the run its origin names.

nodes.name: Raised here?
nodes.notes: Only requests this workflow raised: another flow's confirmation passes by.

nodes.notes: Ours to act on? says why: another key raised it, its origin is forged or another workflow's, it is not an infra_change, or it is not approved any more. Nothing is applied.
